binding_impact: required Phase 7 stale-cleanup replacement-race acceptance criterion
finding.regression_gap: The rc.10 synchronized regression pauses before the final helper executes its identity re-check; it does not synchronize after that final lstat and before unlink.
finding.summary: rc.10 re-validates the classified stale administrator socket with lstat(), then unlinks the pathname in a separate operation. A competing legitimate LAC starter can replace and bind the pathname after the final validation and before unlink(), causing the first contender to remove the replacement live endpoint.

fresh_host_tests_constraint: The connected Web-File-Tool project root is read-only and non-executable. The reviewer inspected live source/evidence and independently reproduced the Unix pathname check-to-unlink interleaving in an isolated local fixture; owner-host test execution was therefore not represented as fresh reviewer execution.
